scope: Bounded trusted evaluator review of accounting wrapper and dispatcher usage-callback changes, using invented accounting metadata only.

authorExecutedSeparately.note: Author combined suite includes these nine independent controls. Reviewer inspected the resulting log; this is not an additional independent 106-test execution.

findings.finding: The composed accounting wrapper reused prospective usage callbacks for an already returned verdict and accepted final observation, potentially discarding a completed measured overrun.
findings.historicalEvidence: Source review before correction. No pre-fix runtime reproduction is claimed.
findings.resolution: Optional final cumulative accounting callback preserves measured totals and reservation-overrun freeze without authorizing additional work. Subsequent prospective usage is rejected.
findings.verifiedBy: Independent composed controls for returned verdict overrun, larger final observation, incomplete final observation, prospective overrun and final callback lifecycle all pass.

findings.finding: Rejected 1001st operation could remain inserted in the in-memory inventory, preventing the failed checkpoint from validating.
findings.historicalEvidence: Author finding; no pre-fix runtime reproduction is claimed.
findings.resolution: Check handle count before inserting a new operation.
findings.verifiedBy: 1001st operation is rejected, exactly 1000 earlier handles remain in the failed checkpoint, and the rejected operation is not forwarded.

findings.finding: A failure while persisting the failed checkpoint could replace the original classified error with private sink text.
findings.historicalEvidence: Author finding; no pre-fix runtime reproduction is claimed.
findings.resolution: Failed-state sink error cannot replace the original safe classified failure.
findings.verifiedBy: Injected private sink error does not appear in the thrown error, adjudication and observer are never entered, and classification remains execution_or_setup_failed.

independentControls: Completed raw final cost overrun remains in result and ledger charge, with sticky reservation-overrun freeze.
Larger accepted cumulative observation replaces phase totals without double counting.
Incomplete final observation leaves final cost and CPU unknown while preserving known charged lower bounds and pending billing.
Prospective overrun stops before the observer and retains measured lower bounds.
Final accounting cannot reopen prospective callbacks or mutate a terminal row.
Retained wrapper callbacks cannot append operations after adjudication quiesces.
Bad observer checkpoint binding cannot erase completed adjudication cost.
Rejected 1001st handle leaves valid 1000-handle failed inventory.
Checkpoint sink failure cannot leak private raw text or start adjudication.
evidenceSeparation: The author separately reproduced and fixed an earlier raw-dispatcher reporting regression (96/97 initial checks). That historical test is recorded in the author receipt and is not claimed as this independent review execution.
limitations: No provider/model calls, candidate execution, actual protected checks, sealed corpus reads or real human results were used. Empty selection maps and live-shaped gates are inert invented test metadata.
This verifies injected accounting/control behavior, not real USD measurement, billing authenticity, remote cancellation, cleanup, retention or quiescence.
The trusted transport must call final usage only after all paid work and cleanup are quiescent and must enforce prospective bounds before side effects.
Checkpoint durability exists only for checkpoints successfully persisted by the injected trusted sink; deliberate sink failure does not prove durable failure recording.
Late remote usage after a deadline or terminalization requires retained external evidence and explicit accounting reconciliation; callbacks cannot reopen terminal rows.
Root owns concrete protected transport composition and source/ledger revalidation around accounting waits. That integration was outside this bounded review.
